title: 秋の味覚
subject_en: Autumn foods, each ONE item centred in its cell, flat illustration with soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: さんま、栗、さつまいも、きのこ、柿、梨、ぶどう、新米など、秋の味覚12点。レシピ、給食だより、チラシのすみに。
items: a grilled Pacific saury fish on a plate with a lemon wedge
two sweet potatoes, one cut open showing yellow flesh
a group of mushrooms in different shapes
a pear and a cut half
a bunch of purple grapes with leaves
a bowl of steaming white rice with chopsticks
ginkgo nuts in a small dish
a green kabocha squash cut in half
